```esql
FROM employees
| EVAL m = (emp_no, salary) IN (FROM employees
                                | SORT emp_no ASC
                                | LIMIT 3
                                | KEEP emp_no, salary)
| WHERE m
| SORT emp_no
| KEEP emp_no
```
